claims: The Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) is a 1990 civil rights law.
The ADA prohibits discrimination against individuals with disabilities in all areas of public life, including jobs, schools, transportation, and public/private places.
Under ADA Title I, employers with 15 or more employees must provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants or employees unless it causes undue hardship.
Reasonable accommodations under ADA Title I include modifying equipment.
Reasonable accommodations under ADA Title I include adjusting schedules.
Reasonable accommodations under ADA Title I include making facilities accessible.
ADA Title II ensures equal access to services, programs, and activities of state and local government.
ADA Title II includes public transportation.
ADA Title II includes web/mobile app accessibility.
ADA Title III requires private entities such as restaurants, hotels, stores, theaters to ensure facilities are accessible.
ADA Title III requires private entities to make reasonable modifications to policies for people with disabilities.
The ADA covers individuals with a physical or mental impairment that substantially limits major life activities as having a disability.
The ADA covers individuals with a record of such impairment as having a disability.
The ADA covers individuals perceived as having such an impairment as having a disability.
The ADA protects against discrimination in hiring, promotion, and firing.
The ADA ensures equal access to goods and services.
The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) enforces ADA Title I.
The U.S. Department of Justice enforces ADA Titles II and III.
ADA violations can result in lawsuits.
ADA violations can result in court orders to comply.
ADA violations can result in significant monetary damages or fines.
Under ADA Title III, penalties can exceed $75,000 for a first violation.
Under ADA Title III, penalties can exceed $150,000 for subsequent violations.
The ADA.gov website emphasizes that Title II and III regulations include requirements for website and mobile application accessibility to ensure equal access to services.
